title: Export button does nothing when clicked
body:
### What happened

Clicking Export on the dashboard does nothing: no file downloads and no error appears.

### What you expected

A CSV file downloads.

### Version or environment

Firefox 131

title: write-commit-message prints an empty message for staged changes
body:
### What happened

I staged two changed files and ran /64x-lunicorn:write-commit-message. It printed "Commit message:" and then nothing, every time.

### What you expected

A Conventional Commits message for the two staged files.

### Version or environment

macOS 15
